entries.speaker: GIOVANNI
entries.chinese_text: 老大:哈哈,这里是我藏身的地方!既然被你发现那就没办法了.我可不会手下留情的!再让你尝尝最强的训练师我沙奇的厉害!!
entries.english_2015: This is my hideout!I planned to resur-rect Team Rocket here! But, you havecaught me again! Sobe it! I'm not holding back! You shall face Giovannithe greatest trainer!
entries.french_v2_gloss: GIOVANNI : Ha ha ! Tu as trouvé ma cachette. Aucune pitié ! Je suis Giovanni, le plus puissant Dresseur !

entries.speaker: GIOVANNI
entries.chinese_text: 老大:虽然不想承认但我还是输了,按照约定这个黑色徽章就交给你了,你一定能成为一位厉害的训练家.我想从今起重新开始我的精灵修行之旅!想暂时解散火箭队!有缘的话我们再见吧!
entries.english_2015: Ha! That was truly an intense fight! You've earned the Earth Badge! It is proof of your mastery as a Pok@mon trainer! With it, you can enter the Pok@mon League! Having lostI cannot face my underlings! Team Rocket is finished forever! I will dedicate my life tothe study of Pok@mon! Let us meet again someday!Farewell!

entries.english_2015: Oak:Oh right! I have a request of you two.Here's my new invention, the Pok@dex.It records data on Pok@mon you've seen or caught.Take them with you! This is a great undertaking in Pok@mon history!
